facts.business: ZF Steering Gear (India) Limited manufactures and supplies steering gear systems for commercial vehicles (including buses) and tractors, and also operates a renewable energy segment.

segments.name: Auto-components (Steering Gear Systems and related components)

key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and crude oil volatility
Below-normal monsoon impacting agricultural output and rural demand
facts.related_party_note: Loans granted to subsidiaries; repayment obligations settled from fresh loans to subsidiaries aggregated Rs. 9.51 crore (9.90% of total loans granted during the year). Investments in subsidiaries pledged as security for loans availed by subsidiaries.
